mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which signals reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in housing starts indicates a contraction in manufacturing and a surge in residential construction, which together signal an overheating economy that triggers a central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline and HOUST rise fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), a decline in real consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, which leads to lower corporate profits and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a decline in RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, with Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the past three months indicates strong residential construction activity, which correlates with rising consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases by at least 1.5% over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI above 3.0% triggers a central bank tightening expectation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment and decline in payroll employment signals a severe labor market contraction, which reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE rise and PAYEMS decline fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, with Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% quarterly), a decline in industrial production indicates a weakening supply chain, which reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO growth < 0.5% quarterly), a decline in INDPRO fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, with Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
